description: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Public Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Központi Statisztikai Hivatal. Coverage: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal. The listing groups 46 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Forgalomba hozott növényvédőszer-hatóanyagok mennyisége [tonna]; Magyarországon első alkalommal forgalomba helyezett új és használt köz; Személysérüléses közúti közlekedési balesetek; A közúti gépjárművek száma járműnemenként, az év végén. Formats seen: CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-kozadatportal.
